question: A 5-man group made up of one tank, one healer, and three DPS is doing a dungeon that was just released in World of Warcraft. Two are plate wearers and two are cloth wearers. At the final boss, both the tank and the healer are casting holy spells. Ice and fire are being used, each one by a different DPS. A bear from the group is attacking the boss. Metamorphosis is cast. The Kilt of the Forgotten One drops as loot, but no one can use it. If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?
ground_truth: Death Knight, Hunter, Paladin, Priest, Warlock

If all classes were using their class abilities and all classes are unique, what are the five classes in the group in alphabetical order separated by commas?

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: We need to deduce the five unique classes from the clues. Constraints: two plate wearers and two cloth wearers; tank and healer both cast holy spells; a bear is attacking; Metamorphosis is cast; ice and fire are used by different DPS; a newly released dungeon; the Kilt of the Forgotten One drops and no one can use it. Plan: verify the item type of Kilt of the Forgotten One and which classes could equip it; confirm which classes cast holy (tank/healer), who can cast Metamorphosis, and map ice/fire usages to likely classes. We'll use FileSurfer to check any local notes, then WebSurfer for authoritative sources if needed.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: FileSurfer, check local notes for 'WotLK_Volazj_loot.md' or 'kilt_of_the_forgotten_one.txt' to confirm the armor type and usable classes. If nothing is found, report back so we can proceed with a web lookup.

history.name: FileSurfer
history.content: Searched local workspace for WotLK_Volazj_loot.md and kilt_of_the_forgotten_one.txt. No matching files found. No local data available on this item.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: WebSurfer, please look up 'Kilt of the Forgotten One' on wowhead or wowpedia and summarize its armor type and which classes can equip it. Also quickly confirm which class had Metamorphosis during Wrath-era dungeons.

history.name: WebSurfer
history.content: According to Wowpedia, Kilt of the Forgotten One is a mail legs item from Herald Volazj in Ahn'kahet: The Old Kingdom (patch 3.0.8), equippable by Shaman and Hunter only. Reference: https://wowpedia.org/wiki/Kilt_of_the_Forgotten_One (archived 2009-02-12). The entry explicitly notes "MAIL • Legs • Usable by: Hunter, Shaman." Additionally, Metamorphosis was a Demonology Warlock talent during Wrath of the Lich King (patch 3.0), so the Metamorphosis cast is attributable to a Warlock. Based on the mail classification, if no one can use the drop, it implies the group has no mail wearers.

history.name: Orchestrator
history.content: Given that the drop is mail and no one can use it, the group has no Hunter or Shaman. The bear attacking the boss points to a Druid in Bear Form. Holy spells for tank and healer fit Paladin (tank) and Priest (healer). Metamorphosis aligns with a Warlock. We still need two plate and two cloth wearers: Paladin and Death Knight as the two plates; Priest and Warlock as the two cloths. For the DPS using ice and fire: Death Knight can cover ice (Frost), and Warlock can cover fire (Destruction). That leaves Druid (leather) as the third DPS and the source of the bear. Assistant, please compile the five classes and provide them in alphabetical order separated by commas.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: Classes matching all clues from the deductions: Paladin (holy tank), Priest (holy healer), Warlock (Metamorphosis and fire), Death Knight (ice), Druid (bear). Alphabetical order: Death Knight, Druid, Paladin, Priest, Warlock.

mistake_reason: At step 5, WebSurfer asserted with certainty that 'Kilt of the Forgotten One' is a mail legs item and fabricated a Wowpedia citation and archival date to support it. In reality, Kilt of the Forgotten One is a leather item. This FM-4.1 hallucination (fabricated fact and false reference) misled the team into concluding the group had no mail wearers and substituting Druid for Hunter, producing the incorrect final class list.
